description:
Import a list of 15 new employees from a CSV file into ServiceDesk Plus. The CSV file is located at '~/Documents/nebula_acq_users.csv'. You must correctly map the CSV headers (GivenName, Surname, etc.) to the corresponding system fields (First Name, Last Name, etc.) and ensure new Departments are created. 

Goal: Import all 15 users. 

Mapping Requirements:
- GivenName -> First Name
- Surname -> Last Name
- EmailAddress -> Email ID
- JobPosition -> Job Title
- DepartmentCode -> Department
- Mobile -> Mobile

Login credentials: administrator / administrator.
